skyMaskPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an EXACT BLACK AND WHITE OCCLUSION MASK of the supplied panoramic illustration, same canvas, same crop, pixel-registered. Paint ONLY unobstructed open sky WHITE. Paint EVERY solid foreground object BLACK: entire city skyline including each tower/spire and roof, mountains, balcony, person, laptop, furniture, plants, every ivy leaf/stem, wooden roof beams, wall and lantern. White sky must remain visible in the small gaps between leaves and buildings wherever the original image shows sky. This is a production luminance mask so moving clouds pass BEHIND buildings and plants; no text, no scenery colors, no shadows, no gradient, no decorative elements.
